message.reasoning_content:
We need count numbers 1..1000 divisible by 3 or 5, exclude those divisible by 7. Use inclusion-exclusion.

Count A = multiples of 3: floor(1000/3)=333.
B = multiples of 5: floor(1000/5)=200.
A∩B = multiples of 15: floor(1000/15)=66.

So total divisible by 3 or 5 = 333+200-66=467.

Now need to subtract those that are also divisible by 7 (i.e., divisible by 7 and (3 or5)). Count numbers divisible by 7 and 3: lcm 21. floor(1000/21)=47.
Divisible by 7 and5: lcm 35. floor(1000/35)=28.
Divisible by 7 and both 3 and5 i.e., lcm of 3,5,7 =105. floor(1000/105)=9.

Numbers divisible by 7 and (3 or5) = 47+28-9=66.

Thus desired = 467 - 66 = 401.

Answer integer only: 401.
